text.tspan: Use of interpolation and extrapolation on original Gini coefficient data, 1820
In order to produce global estimates of historical poverty trends we have interpolated or extrapolated inequality data
for missing observations. Green indicates observations of the Gini coefficient available in the original source.
Source: OWID based on Maddison Project Database 2020; GCIP; van Zanden et al. (2014), de la Escosura (2012)
